content.value_statement: Cypress questions can produce incorrect tests when answers rely on memory or outdated examples. This skill finds official documentation and returns structured, source-grounded guidance.
actual_capabilities: Search official Cypress documentation before answering version-sensitive questions.
Prefer LLM-friendly Cypress documentation paths when they are available.
Extract command syntax, arguments, return behavior, and examples.
Route error-message questions to the Cypress error reference.
Explain configuration options with types, defaults, and examples.
State uncertainty when official documentation cannot verify a claim.
limitations: It covers Cypress documentation and does not replace project-specific debugging.
It needs access to current official Cypress documentation for verification.
It cannot guarantee behavior in unsupported browsers or unpublished Cypress versions.
It does not write, run, or repair tests unless another skill handles that work.

use_cases.title: Confirm API usage
use_cases.description: Find verified syntax and options for a Cypress command before implementing a test.

use_cases.title: Investigate test errors
use_cases.description: Match a Cypress error message with official explanations and relevant guidance.

use_cases.title: Review Cypress changes
use_cases.description: Check whether a proposed test pattern matches current Cypress documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Find a command
prompt_templates.prompt: How do I use cy.intercept in Cypress? Use official documentation and include a short example.

prompt_templates.title: Explain configuration
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the official Cypress documentation for retries. Explain its type, default behavior, and configuration example.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose an error
prompt_templates.prompt: Research this Cypress error in official documentation: [paste error]. Explain likely causes and supported next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Compare behavior by version
prompt_templates.prompt: Verify whether [Cypress feature] behaves differently in Cypress [version] versus the latest stable release. Cite official sources and state uncertainty.

output_examples.input: How do I stub a GET request in Cypress?
output: A verified explanation of cy.intercept for GET requests.
The required route matcher and response options.
A concise official-style example and notes about waiting for the alias.

output_examples.input: What does this Cypress error mean? [error text]
output: A clear explanation of the error.
Supported troubleshooting steps and any limits on confidence.

best_practices: Provide the Cypress version when the question may depend on version-specific behavior.
Include the complete error message when investigating a failing test.
Ask for official sources when using guidance in production test suites.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill as a substitute for running or debugging a local test suite.
Do not treat unverified examples from third-party sites as official Cypress behavior.
Do not omit version details when comparing deprecated or changing APIs.

faq.question: What does this skill search?
faq.answer: It prioritizes official Cypress documentation and Cypress website content.

faq.question: Does it write Cypress tests?
faq.answer: It provides verified documentation guidance. Use a test-authoring tool for implementation work.

faq.question: Can it explain Cypress errors?
faq.answer: Yes. It routes error questions to official error references and related documentation.

faq.question: Why does it prefer LLM-friendly pages?
faq.answer: Those pages provide cleaner structured content for accurate extraction.

faq.question: Does it support version-specific questions?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the Cypress version so it can identify documented behavior differences.

faq.question: What happens when documentation is unclear?
faq.answer: It states that the claim could not be verified and avoids inventing an answer.
